_note: Hand labels for the 2026-10-24 Whiterun Guard session (docs/session-review-2026-10-24.md). Use with build-set --annotations; --annotated-only keeps only these turns.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#0.notes: Plain greeting to a guard. A short wary greeting, no tool.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#1.notes: Crude insult to the guard's mother. A proud Nord guard starts a Brawl at once (family insult) and says so in one or two lines. Never Attack over words, no AddToConversation.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#2.notes: Mid-brawl the player yields and offers money. The guard ends the fight (StandDown or Forgiven) or scorns the bribe; no new hostility, no AddToConversation.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#3.notes: Player apologises after the brawl. The guard accepts coldly (Forgiven/StandDown fine, or no tool). No fight.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#4.notes: Another jab about the guard's mother after an apology. Warn or Brawl; never Attack over words; no AddToConversation.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#7.notes: Player's sentence breaks off ('there are two...'). Ask them to finish or speak plainly. No tool.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#8.notes: Player claims a grenade that could destroy the city is in the barrels and asks the guard to check. Grenades do not exist in Skyrim: treat as nonsense, a joke or a lie, maybe glance (Look) or tell the player to open it. Never ReportCrime, Attack, AddToConversation or CheckDirections.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#9.notes: Player insists there is a bomb in the jars to defuse. Same as a grenade: nonsense to a Skyrim guard, not a crime. Look or scorn; no arrest, no calling others.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#11.notes: Player asks the guard to check the barrel. A willing guard uses Look (sees what the player sees) or tells the player to open it. Never CheckDirections for a nearby object, never AddToConversation.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#13.notes: 'There is a barrel right next to me, can you check it?' Look is the tool for checking something nearby.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#14.notes: 'Can you inspect the barrels please, I'm scared.' Look; possibly wary because of the earlier bomb story.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#17.notes: 'Guard, I need help.' Ask what is wrong. No tool.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#18.notes: 'This barrel I'm looking at is dangerous, please inspect it.' Look; scepticism about the earlier tales is fine.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#21.notes: Asks the way to Riverwood. Tell the way (south along the road); CheckDirections(Riverwood) is fine. No AddToConversation.

20261024-192246-95b6ab#22.notes: Asks where Riverwood is and to mark it on the map: CheckDirections for Riverwood plus a short spoken answer.
